subject: Duplicate charge — credit memo routing & tax evidence for payment release
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@quantumco.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: accounts_payable@quantumco.io
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discrepancy on Jan invoice — potential duplicate charges

Hi Irene,

We were reconciling our January statement and noticed two line items that look duplicated on Invoice #2027-01 (attached). Our AP team has put the payment for that invoice on hold pending clarification.

Summary:
- Invoice: 2027-01, total USD 37,842.50
- Duplicate lines: two identical usage lines for 2027-01-03 (both USD 2,450.00)
- We need: corrected invoice or credit memo + VAT documentation so our payments team can release funds.

We also need a simple remittance statement showing the net due after any credit so our ERP can process it. Can you confirm next steps and an estimated timeline?

Attachments: QuantumCo_Invoice_20270101.pdf, invoice_202701_duplicate_lines.csv

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Finance Operations
QuantumCo

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@quantumco.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on Jan invoice — potential duplicate charges

Hi Sanjay — thanks for flagging this. I’ve looped in Finance (Marcus) and Account Lead (Marissa). We’ll get you a path to resolution today.

Immediate plan:
- Marcus will validate the duplicate lines and prepare a credit memo or corrected invoice.
- We will provide VAT proof for QuantumCo to attach to your payment record.
- If you prefer, we can net the credit against your next invoice instead of issuing an immediate refund — confirm which you prefer.

Marcus / Marissa — can you pick this up? Marcus, please include a one-line reference for AP (net amount, credit memo id, and expected posting date). Marissa, please weigh in if you'd prefer a goodwill credit for the inconvenience.

Irene
Irene Choi
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@quantumco.io>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 15:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on Jan invoice — potential duplicate charges

I validated the attached CSV against our billing system. There are indeed two identical usage postings that should not have both been billed. Summary of remediation options and proposed calculation below.

Proposed remediation (preferred): credit memo + VAT evidence, post within 3 business days, AP to apply credit to open invoice or refund at QuantumCo request.

Calculation (USD):
- Duplicate usage line x1: 2,450.00
- Withholding/TDS (if applicable): 0.00 (US customer)
- Service goodwill concession (one-time apology credit): 250.00
- Net credit to be issued: 2,700.00

Actions I will take:
1) Generate Credit Memo CM-00083 and attach corrected remittance statement.
2) Package our VAT certificate and the transaction audit extract for your records (vat_certificate_quantumco.pdf).
3) Post the credit to our ledger and share the posting date (expected 2027-01-18).

Attachments to follow: credit_memo_00083.pdf (draft), remittance_statement_QC_net.pdf

Notes / options:
- If you want the amount netted against next invoice, confirm and we will include the credit on Invoice 2027-02.
- If you require a wire refund, provide bank details and we will issue a refund after legal sign-off (2–5 business days).

Marcus Lin
Revenue Accounting Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@quantumco.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on Jan invoice — potential duplicate charges

Thanks Marcus — that sounds reasonable. A couple of clarifications from our side:

1) QuantumCo prefers netting the credit against the next invoice (less AP overhead). Please include the credit on Invoice 2027-02 and issue a remittance statement we can attach when we release payment.

2) For cross-border tax purposes, we also need the VAT certificate and a short one-line confirmation that this credit is for a billing correction (not a service change) so our tax team can treat it as a reduction to taxable supplies.

3) We are operating in India for part of this contract; if any TDS documentation is needed, we’ll advise separately.

Can you confirm the posting date again and send the corrected invoice PDF and remittance statement. AP will clear payment within 48 hours of receiving those docs.

Best,
Sanjay

On Fri, Jan 15, 2027 at 11:03 AM Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Hi Sanjay — thanks for flagging this. I’ve looped in Finance (Marcus) and Account Lead (Marissa). We’ll get you a path to resolution today.

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@quantumco.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Jan 2027 16:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on Jan invoice — credit memo CM-00083 issued and remittance docs

Hi Sanjay — following up with the confirmed artifacts. Apologies for the delay; we wanted to ensure all tax evidence and ledger posting were complete before sending.

What we did:
- Credit memo CM-00083 issued for USD 2,700.00 (duplicate line + USD 250 goodwill). Attached: credit_memo_00083.pdf.
- VAT certificate for QuantumCo included (vat_certificate_quantumco.pdf).
- Remittance statement for AP included (remittance_statement_QC_net.pdf).
- Credit posted to your account on 2027-01-18; it will appear on Invoice 2027-02 as a line item 'Applied credit CM-00083' and reduce net due.

Next steps for AP:
1) Once you receive Invoice 2027-02 (with the applied credit), you should be able to release payment.
2) If your tax team needs a one-line confirmation: 'Credit CM-00083 issued for billing correction (duplicate charge) — not a change in services.' I’ve attached the one-line confirmation as part of the remittance statement.
3) If you prefer DocuSign for acceptance, sign here: https://www.docusign.com/TP/Signing/123456789 — signing is optional but helpful for audit trails.

If you want the refund instead of netting, send bank details and we’ll start a wire after legal signs off; timeline ~3 business days from instruction.

Thanks for working through this. Marissa, flag anything else we should offer (courtesy credit, onboarding support, etc.).

Irene Choi
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
